title: केकी जो बनावै तौ बनैयौ बनराज जू कौं - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, राधा शतक (110)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
केकी जो बनावै तौ बनैयौ बनराज जू कौं,
कूक कूक नाच नाच सुजस सुनाऊँ मैं। [1]
लता द्रुम बेली रंगरेली जो करौ तौ करौ,
रावरे ही अंगन पै पुष्प-झर लाऊँ मैं॥ [2]
जो पै रज-रेनुका बनावौ मन भायौ ये ही,
तौ पै पद पंकजन सीस पै धराऊँ मैं। [3]
ये ही बर पाऊँ ललचाऊँ सुख साधे राधे,
बास दे निकुंजन को तेरौ ही कहाऊँ मैं॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, राधा शतक (110)
english_text:
(kavitta)
kekee jo banavai tau banaiyau banaraj joo kaun,
kook kook nach nach sujas sunaoon main. [1]
lata drum belee rngarelee jo karau tau karau,
ravare hee angan pai pushpa-jhar laoon main.. [2]
jo pai raja-renuka banavau man bhayau ye hee,
tau pai pad pnkajan sees pai dharaoon main. [3]
ye hee bar paoon lalachaoon sukh sadhe radhe,
bas de nikunjan ko terau hee kahaoon main.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer, braj binod, radha shatak (110)

title: ह्म लोक पर्यंत सुख - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (45)
sanskrit_text:
ब्रह्म लोक पर्यंत सुख, अरु मुक्तिहुँ सुख त्याग।
तबै धरहु पग प्रेम पथ, नहिं लगि जैहैं दाग॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (45)
english_text:
brahm lok parynt sukh, aru muktihun sukh tyag.
tabai dharahu pag prem path, nahin lagi jaihain dag..
- jagadguru shree kripalu jee maharaj, bhakti shatak (45)
english_translation:

title: Chitvat Chit Karshat Jite - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (54)
sanskrit_text: Chitvat Chit Karshat Jite, Chitt Samadhi Mahan Laay.Auran Ki Ka Baat Kaha, Shiv Gopi Tanu Paay.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (54)With a single rasa-filled glance of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even the greatest paramahaṁsas forget their deep states of samādhi — and what to speak of such realized souls, when even Lord Śiva Himself assumed the form of a gopī in order to taste that divine nectar.

title: Aandesh Ke Gaman Ko - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vrindavan Shatak Pratham (34)
sanskrit_text: Aandesh Ke Gaman Ko, Matkar Vir Vichar.Pher Kahan Vrindavipin, Kahan Yah Jugal Bihar.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vrindavan Shatak Pratham (34)O brother, do not even in a dream contemplate the thought of going to any other place or land. Where else can one find such a supremely divine place as Śrī Vṛndāvana, where the divine Couple eternally perform Their nitya-vihāra? Therefore, never lose this most blessed fortune of residing in this holy land.

title: Radhike Kahe Karo Hath Ri - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (65)
sanskrit_text: (Savaiya) Radhike Kahe Karo Hath Ri, Sunari Bar Bol Piyush Se Pi Ke. [1] Bhaunhain Chadhaya Kaha Satrai Ke, Nain Nachaya Bakai Gun Sike. [2] Sambhu Suresh Ganesh Na Pavat, Prem Ke Dore Bandhe Tub Hi Ke. [3] Mano Manayo Paraun Pare, Man Bhavan Mohan Bhavate Ji Ke. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (65)O Rādhike, why do You hold on to this gentle sulk without reason? Please listen for a moment to the sweet, nectar-like words of Your beloved. [1]Why do You sit with raised brows in loving displeasure, glancing playfully and speaking such sharp words, as if learned from elsewhere? [2]Lord Kṛṣṇa, whom even Lord Śiva, Indra, and Gaṇeśa cannot easily attain, is bound solely by the rope of Your love. [3]Your beloved Manmohana, who pleases Your heart, lies in Your lotus-feet, trying to appease You. Therefore, O Kiśorī Jī, please be pleased now and accept His loving plea. [4]

title: Shri Vrishbhan Kishori Sujan - Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Shri Radhashtak (01)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Shri Vrishbhan Kishori Sujaan, Sunau Vinati Sudhi Leu Hamari. [1]Aapni Jani Kripa Kariken, Hansi Heri Kahau Sakhi Aau Hamari. [2]Naam Kahun Gun Gai Rahun, Pad-Kanj Bina Gati Hai Na Hamari. [3]Paas Rahai Paramanand Shrihit, Radhika Jeevan Praan Hamari. [4]- Shri Hita Parmanand Das, Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Shri Radhashtak (01)O ever-fresh, youthful Skillful Queen, Śrī Rādhā! Kindly hear my plea and think about this humble soul. [1]Considering me as Your maidservant, bestow such grace upon me that You glance toward me with a gentle smile and say, “O sakhī, come near to me.” [2]May I constantly call out Your holy Name and sing Your glories, for apart from Your lotus feet, I have no other shelter. [3]Śrī Hita Paramānanda Dāsa Jī says: this alone is my longing that I may always remain near You, serving you selflessly, for, O Śrī Rādhikā Jī, You alone are the very life and soul of my existence. [4]

title: Indra-Mad-Mardan Durg - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (5)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitta) Indra-Mad-Mardan Durg Giri Gobarddhan Hai, Amrit Saman Bahai Yamuna Ka Panee Hai. [1] Prem Ka Prakash Yahin Rasaka Vikas Hua, Jisaki Amar Ek Uttam Kahanee Hai. [2] Vraj-Nav-Yuvaraj Hain Rajya Karate Jahan, Radhika Saman Sarva Shreshth Maharanee Hai. [3] Preeti Kee Pataka Hai Udati Raj Mandir Pai, Vrindavan Prem Kee Pavitra Rajadhanee Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (5)Girirāja Govardhana stands as the divine fortress that crushed the pride of Indra, while the sacred waters of Śrī Yamunā Jī flow there like nectar. [1]It is in this land that divine love manifested, and where the Mahārāsa took place — those eternal and supreme pastimes revered even today. [2]Here reigns Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the youthful prince of Braja, and here resides Śrī Rādhikā Mahārānī, the supreme Queen. [3]Upon the royal temple of this land, the banner of pure selfless love forever flutters — such is Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma, the sacred capital of divine love. [4]

title: Yadaiva Sachchidrasarupa - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.84)
sanskrit_text: Yadaiva Sachchidrasarupa Buddhivrrindavanasthasthirajamgameshu.Syannirvyalikam Purushastadaiva Chakasti Radhapriya Sevirupah.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.84)When one develops a pure realization of all beings — both moving and unmoving — within Śrī Vṛndāvana as embodiments of Sata-Chita-Rasa (eternal existence, pure consciousness, and divine rasa), only then does one attain the eligibility to become a beloved maidservant of Śrī Rādhā, fit for Her intimate service.

title: Lochan Syam Sudhir Ke - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (63)
sanskrit_text: Lochan Syam Sudhir Ke, Mochan Virah Visaal.Bin Hi Anjan Yeh Aho, Khanjan Lochan Baal.- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (63)Śrī Raṅgadevī Jī says to Śrī Lalitā Jī: O Lalite! Behold the eyes of Śrī Rādhā — how they shine like the graceful khanjana birds. Although Śrī Rādhā has not adorned Her eyes with collyrium, even without it, these khanjana-like glances possess the power to dispel the pangs of separation from the heart of Vṛndāvana-Bihārī, Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

title: Makhan Ten Makhatulhu Te - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (79)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Makhan Ten Makhatulhu Ten, Sukumar Siroman Kanj Kali Ke. [1]Lal Gulal Praval Ke Bhushan, Dushan Hain Ghanshyam Chhali Ke. [2]Aali Gulab Ko Aabahi Variye, Chariye Ye Brajkunj Thali Ke. [3]Bhanu Pratap Kau Nindit Hai, Pad Bandat Haun Vrishbhanlali Ke. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (79)The lotus feet of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s daughter are softer than butter and finer than silk. They are more tender than the delicate buds of a lotus. [1]Those sacred feet are deep red like gulāla and coral gems, and so powerful in beauty that they subdue even the pride of the beauty of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [2]O sakhī, even the radiance and charm of a rose deserve to be offered in surrender before those feet, for they wander gracefully through the kuñjas of Braja. [3]Before the brilliance of those feet, even the splendor of the sun appears pale and diminished. Śrī Haṭhī Jī declares that he bows down in honor to those very lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārāṇī Jū. [4]

title: Desh Deshantar Ke Anek - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (9)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Desh Deshantar Ke Anek Vyakti Aate Yahan,Jinke Hriday Mein Jalti Prem-Jwala Hai. [1]Gopi Guru Gaurav Se Raj Rahe Kunjana Mein,Pakar Pravesh Hota Chit Matwala Hai. [2]Prem Ki Pariksha Hoti Prem Ka Hi Prashnapatra,Prem Ka Praman-Patra Milta Nirala Hai. [3]Uddhav Se Shishya Jahan Aaye Path Padhne Ko,Vrindavan Prem Ki Pavitra Pathshala Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (9)From distant lands and regions, countless souls are irresistibly drawn here, their hearts ablaze with the burning flame of love. [1]Within these sacred kuñjas, the gopīs shine resplendent, established upon the exalted seat of the guru. The very moment a seeker gains entry here, the heart becomes intoxicated with the bliss of love. [2]Here, love alone is examined, and love itself forms the question. Upon passing, one receives a wondrous certificate of divine love. [3]It is none other than Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma — the supremely sacred academy of divine love — where even Uddhava, the most exalted among the wise, came as a humble student to learn the lesson of divine love. [4]

[2]Prem Ki Pariksha Hoti Prem Ka Hi Prashnapatra,Prem Ka Praman-Patra Milta Nirala Hai. [3]Uddhav Se Shishya Jahan Aaye Path Padhne Ko,Vrindavan Prem Ki Pavitra Pathshala Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (9)From distant lands and regions, countless souls are irresistibly drawn here, their hearts ablaze with the burning flame of love. title: Aaye Fag Khelan Gopal Barsane Mein - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Aaye Faag Khelan Gopal Barsane Mein,Gaaven Khyaal De De Taal, Ur Harashat Hain. [1]Itte Kishori Gori Sakhin Ke Yooth Mahan,Lekar Abeer Pai Kapol Parasat Hain. [2]Kanchan Pichkari Taki Maarat Bihari Neer,‘Laal Balbir’ Ang Preet Darasat Hain. [3]Chhatan Ten Chhajjan Ten Jharokhan Ten Mokhan Ten,Aaj Nandalal Pai Gulaal Barasat Hain. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu ShatakŚrī Gopāla has arrived in Barsānā to celebrate the joyous festival of Phāga (Holī). All around, people sing the songs of Phāguna, clap their hands in rhythmic beat, and every heart sways in delight. [1]Meanwhile, the fair Kiśorī, Śrī Rādhā, stepping gracefully forward from amidst Her circle of sakhīs, takes abīra (scented powder) in Her hands and lovingly applies it upon the cheeks of Śyāmasundara. [2]On the other side, Bāṅke Bihārī raises His golden water-guns and showers streams of color. Śrī Lāla Balabīra says it appears as though from every limb of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the very hue of divine love itself is overflowing. [3]From rooftops, balconies, latticed windows, and from every side, every corner, people are joyfully raining gulāla upon Śrī Kṛṣṇa on this festive day. [4]

title: Khanjan Mrig Saramay Ke - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (01)
sanskrit_text: Khanjan Mrig Saramay Ke, Vipin Basai Din Rain.Safari Sarasij Jal Chhipe, Dekhi Shyaam Ke Nain. - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (01)Upon beholding the playful, captivating eyes of Śyāmasundara, the wagtail birds and the deer were overcome with shame, choosing to dwell deep within the forest day and night. Likewise, the fish and the lotus blossoms sought refuge beneath the waters, hiding away after witnessing those beautiful eyes.

title: Ma Kurukarma Na Yogam - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (7.09)
sanskrit_text: Ma Kurukarma Na Yogam Na Vishnubhajanam Na Va Shravanam‌.Dhruvamavapsyasi Parapadam Vrrindaranye Yatha Tatha Tishthan‌.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (7.09)Do not engage in pious deeds, do not practice yoga, do not worship Lord Viṣṇu, and do not listen to His glories. By merely residing in the sacred land of Vṛndāvana, you will surely attain the highest spiritual perfection.

title: Govardhane Krrita Yena Pritih Shri Harivallabhe - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (90)
sanskrit_text: Govardhane Krrita Yena Pritih Shri Harivallabhe.Manusham Janmamasadya Tena Sarvam Shubham Krritam.- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (90)One who, having attained a human birth, develops love for Śrī Girirāja Govardhana, the most beloved of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, accomplishes all auspicious deeds in this world; indeed, the birth of such a person alone is truly fulfilled.

title: Baithi Rang Bhari Hai Rangili - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (18)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Baithi Rang Bhari Hai Rangili Rang Ravati Mein,Kahan Lau Bakhanau, Sundarai Sirtaj Ki. [1]Chandani Ki, Champak Ki, Chanchala Chamikar Ki,Indma, Tilottama Ki Sobha Kaun Kaj Ki. [2]Motin Ke Har Garen, Motin Sau Maang Bharai,Motin Saun Beni Guhi Hathi Sukhsaj Ki. [3]Chal Gajraj, Mrigraj Ki-Si Lank Duj,Raaj-Sau Vadan, Rajai Rani Brajraj Ki. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (18)Immersed in the colors of divine love, the playful Śrī Rādhā graces the pavilion of Raṅga Mahala with incomparable beauty. How can the limitless splendor of such a supreme crowned queen ever be contained within mere words? [1]The brilliance of moonlight, the tenderness of champak blossoms, the radiance of molten gold, and the combined beauty of celestial maidens Indumatī and Tilottama—all fade before even a single glimpse of Her divine form. [2]Beautiful pearl necklaces adorn her neck, her parting is decorated with pearls, and her braid is woven with pearls as well—her entire adornment overflows with unparalleled charm. [3]Her majestic gait sways like an intoxicated elephant king, Her slender waist moves with the elegant grace of a lioness, and Her radiant complexion glows with royal splendor. Thus, Śrī Rādhā, the Queen of Braj’s Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa is gracefully seated. [4]

title: Bhrikuti Bank Garh Madhya Mein - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (07)
sanskrit_text: Bhrikuti Bank Garh Madhya Mein, Nayan Kothari Vand. Radha Kripa Kataaksh Bin, Mile Na Gokulchand. - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (07)The arched eyebrows rise like a fortress, with the eyes as its sealed chambers. Without the merciful, grace-filled glance of Śrī Rādhā, the vision and attainment of Gokulchand, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, are utterly impossible.

title: Rasikjan Ki Main Balihari - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Sri Rasik Bhaktjan Mahimamrit (177.2)
sanskrit_text: (Pad Rekhta)Rasikjan Ki Main Balihari, Piya Pyari Jin Ur Dhari.Vrindavan Dham Mein Dolen, Amani Mande Bolen. [1]Sabhi Se Prem Hitkari, Trigun Se Riti Jin Nyari.Prem Mein Magan Gun Gaven, Madhuri Tinko Shirnaven. [2]- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Sri Rasik Bhaktjan Mahimamrit (177.2)I offer myself in sacrifice to those rasika devotees in whose hearts the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, eternally and exclusively dwell. They dwell in the sacred land of Vṛndāvan, free from false prestige, yet their words bestow honor upon all. [1]Loving toward everyone and devoted to the welfare of all, their love transcends the three modes of material nature. Absorbed in pure, selfless divine love, they ceaselessly sing the glories of the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Alī Mādhurī bows her head humbly at their feet. [2]

title: Sanvar Sasi Sang Lasi Priya - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (67)
sanskrit_text: Sanvar Sasi Sang Lasi Priya, Bhari Saras Ras Chhand. Dolat Hain Shri Radhika, Ati Hi Aju Anand. - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (67)Just as moonlight appears splendid with the moon, likewise Shri Radhika, immersed in divine bliss, shines supremely beautiful beside Shyamsundar. Today, she is swaying, overflowing with the ecstasy of love-bliss.

title: Kirtan Ke Yuth Dekh Utthi Umang Ek - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (3)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kirtan Ke Yuth Dekh Utthi Umang Ek,Govardhan Ko Dekh Govardhan Dharaiya Ki. [1]Bhul Jata Gyan Sabhi, Dekh “Gyan Gudri” Ko,Chir Ghat Dekhkar, Chir Ke Churaiya Ki. [2]Seva Kunj Dekh Sudh Hoti Shyamsundar Ki,Vanshi Vat Dekh-Dekh, Vanshi Ke Bajaiya Ki. [3]Yamuna Hiloren Dekh Hilta Hriday Hay,Kalidah Dekh Yaad Aati Hai Kanhaiya Ki. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (3)In the sacred land of Śrī Vṛndāvan, the heart overflows with joy upon seeing groups of devotees singing in kīrtan-maṇḍalīs; a glance at Govardhan instantly evokes the memory of Lord Kṛṣṇa lifting this divine hill. [1]Seeing ‘Jñāna Guḍaḍī’, all acquired knowledge seems insignificant; a glimpse of ‘Cīra Ghāṭa’ immediately brings to mind the playful Lord Kṛṣṇa who stole the Gopīs’ clothes. [2]‘Sevā Kuñja’ awakens the divine remembrance of Śyāmasundar serving Śrī Rādhā; ‘Vāṁśīvaṭa’ enchants the mind with the sweet memory of the flute‑playing Kṛṣṇa. [3]The rippling waters of the Yamunā stir the heart with waves of divine love; Kālīdaha reminds one vividly of Kānhā’s heroic subduing of the serpent Kāliya. [4]

title: Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Pyari Preetam Paraspar, Rachyo Ang Anurag.Adhar Sudha Ras Det Hain, Let Syam Badbhag.(Pad) [Iktal, Raag-Vihagarau]Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari.Rachyo Paraspar Prem Chem, Badhyo Ati Bhari. [1]Arpyo Piy Hiy Pay Cain, Nij Adhar Sudhari.Shribhat Badbhagi Gopal, Piyo Ruchikari. [2]- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)(Doha)Shri Priyā Ju and her beloved Shri Krishna are absorbed in the sweetness of divine conjugal love﻿. Their hearts overflow with the ocean of divine bliss. Blessed Shri Lālaji’s mind, like a bee, becomes intoxicated by drinking adharāmṛta﻿ (the nectar of the lips) of Shri Priya Ji.(Pada)Shri Bhatt Ji says — Queen of Vṛndāvan, Shri Rādhā, and Vṛndāvanvihārī Lāla are both the very ocean of rasa﻿. On the bower-bed, immersed in mutual love’s sweetness, waves of bliss surge through their hearts, and their entire beings overflow with divine bliss. [1]O Sakhi! When Shri Lālaji’s heart was filled with deep longing to taste adharāmṛta﻿, the supremely compassionate Shri Priyāji offered her own divine nectar in love. Shri Bhatt Ji says—Shri Gopāl Lāl, feeling supremely blessed, lovingly drank the nectar of Shri Priyāji. Thus, the divine couple joyfully engages in divine plays of love on the bed, granting bliss to all rasikas. [2]

title: Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou Chhahgir Keenai Kou,Beenai Le Prabeenai Ye Naveenen Sur Gaavati. [1]Kou Jari Jorai Kar Atar Gulab Borai,Lai Lai Alabeli Hathi Dhavan Tain Aavati. [2]Kou Chaur Dharai Kou Aarti Utarai Kou,Karti Salamen Kou Mujra Na Paavati. [3]Baithi Aan Takhat Pai Bakhat Biland Radhe,Bala Digpalan Ki Mala Pahiraavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)One sakhī stands holding a royal canopy above Her, another holds a mirror before Her, while yet another sings sweet melodies, playing the vīṇā to please Her divine heart. [1]One lovingly adorns Her with garments of gold, another sprinkles fragrant rose water and perfume, and yet another rushes forward in eagerness to serve the enchanting Sovereign Queen, Śrī Rādhā. [2]One waves a fly‑whisk, another performs Her āratī; one offers prostrations in reverence, while another greets Her with folded hands in deep devotion. [3]Śrī Rādhā sits gracefully upon Her jeweled throne, while celestial queens lovingly place garlands around Her neck. [4]

title: Keet Patang Pipilika Markat Bhring Mayur - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)
sanskrit_text: Keet Patang Pipilika, Markat Bhring Mayur.Jugalvihari Kijiye, Vrindavan Ki Dhoor.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)Whether as an insect, a moth, an ant, a monkey, a bumblebee, or even a peacock — grant me any form that pleases You. O Divine Couple! Bless me to become one with the dust of Vṛndāvan, ever resting at Your holy lotus feet.

title: Jaake Pad Neti Neti - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaake Pad Neti Neti Bandat Sures Sesh,Tere Pad Sees Naay Thaadhe Kar Jori Ri. [1]Jetau Nat Nagar Tu Naagari Chhabeeli Baal,Kahaa Pratipaal Bhayi Aisi Mat Bhori Ri. [2]Lal Balbeer Mil Dou Ras Rang Keejai,Deejai Sukh Nainan Kau Maani Binai Mori Ri. [3]Rahi Rain Thori Ab Sain Karau Gori,Kunj Preetam Ke Sang Mili Keerati Kisori Ri. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)The One whose feet are worshiped even by Indra and Śeṣanāga, who glorify Him as “beyond all description” — that Supreme Brahman, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, bows down with folded hands before Your lotus feet. [1]If He is the supreme master of divine play, then You are the supreme enchantress who captivates even Him, the most graceful and charming of all; tell me, O my tender‑hearted protectress, why do You behave so innocently today? [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir Jī humbly prays — O Rādhe! Please set aside Your loving pride and joyfully unite with Your Beloved, granting us, Your sahacarīs (companions), the bliss of witnessing that divine union. [3]O fair daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, beloved Rādhe! The night has nearly passed; the time has come — now lovingly repose with Your Beloved in the grove of divine pleasure. [4]

title: Puran Prem Sudhanidhi Saar Ki - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Puran Prem Sudhaanidhi Saar Ki Moorati Manju Bani Ik Raajai.Keli Mahotsav Mein Hulsi Ras Ki Ghan Moorati Dooji Viraajai. [1]Radhika Ke Pad-Kanj Vilodat Morapakha Atihi Chhavi Chhaajai.Shri Barsane Sumandir Raajat Laadileelaal Ki Bolo Sadaajai. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaOn one side sits the beautiful Śrī Rādhā, who is the very source and essence of divine love; on the other, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is filled with the sweetness of rasa, is joyfully present in the keli-mahotsav (divine play festival). [1]Kṛṣṇa's peacock feather crown gently touches the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, making Śrī Rādhā's form even more charming. Let us always sing the praises of Ladilī lāl (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa), who dwells in the lovely temple of Barsāna. [2]

title: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)
sanskrit_text: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo Naapi Vrinda-Vanam Naiva Vrindani Tat PremabhajamSadaa Yasya Hrada-Gochare Vaatha Vaachaam Prachaare Katham Tasya Rasa-Shrih.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)One whose heart Shri Radha, Shri Krishna, Shri Vrindavan, and Their loving rasika devotees (sahacharis) do not ever manifest — and from whose speech they are never spoken — how can such a person ever taste the most wondrous Rasa-Shri (Vrindavan Rasa)?

title: Jaat Rupa Takhat Pe Baithi Roop Rasi Radhe - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaat Roop Takhat Pai Baithi Roop Raasi Radhe,Angan Ki Prabha Prabhakar Ko Lajavati. [1]Cheer Chaaru Heer Haar Hiy Pehiraay Kar,Bhushan Bnaay Baal Saajan Sajaavati. [2]Atar Gulaab Lai Sugandhan Lagaavai Sabai,Chandan Chadhaay Bhaal Bhauran Bhagaavati. [3]Jori Jori Paani Devtaan Hoon Ki Rani Hathi,Koti Koti Kornis Jhuki Kai Bajaavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)When Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the infinite mine of beauty, sits gracefully upon Her golden throne, the radiance of Her divine limbs shames even the brilliance of the sun. [1]Her intimate sakhīs lovingly adorn Her with beautiful garments, garlands of diamonds and pearls, and precious ornaments with their delicate hands. [2]They anoint Her with rose‑scented oils and fragrant essences, apply sandal paste to Her forehead, and gently wave away the bees drawn to Her divine fragrance. [3]Śrī Hathi Jī says — even the queens of the celestial gods come with folded hands, bowing countless times, playing kornish (a melodious ceremonial instrument), and offering reverent obeisance at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]

title: Pashu Pakshi Pashan Hon - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)
sanskrit_text: Pashu Pakshi Paashaan Hon, Trin Anu Raj Braj Gail.Koop Baavari Keejiye, Lalit Kishori Chhail.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)O Lalit Kishori (Shri Radha), please grant me the grace to become anything in the pathways of Braj — a bird, animal, stone, a blade of grass, or even a speck of dust. Even as a well, a stepwell, or a lifeless object, my only prayer is to never be born or dwell outside the dust of Braj-dham.

title: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)
sanskrit_text: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam Vadhambudhavanuddhara.Vrrindavanamapi Mandayata Iha Karunardradrrik‌ Prasare.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)The one who commits an offense against Shri Radha Maharani, because of those endless offenses, falls into the ocean of worldly obstacles and is deprived of deliverance. title: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana - Shri Kishori Ali, Radhashtak (01)
sanskrit_text: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana Krrishnatate ViharatanvitaKrishnasara. title: Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulari Radha - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Radha,Sahaj Sakhin Lai Nikunjan Ko Dagari. [1]Charan Ki Chauki Ki Chamak Chaaru Angan Ki,Kayo Rang Rangan Ki Jyoti Braj Bagari. [2]Dekhai Pag Dwarei Varei Tan Man Pran Hathi,Roop Chak Chaundha Rahi Chauk Sab Nagari. [3]Kaidhau Sukhma Hai Kai Dama Hai Ke Tama Hai Kai,Uma Hai Induma Hai Kai Rama Hai Roop Aagari. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s charming daughter Rādhā, along with Her sakhīs, is walking gracefully toward the path of the Nikunj (divine grove). [1]The divine presence of Her footprints has illuminated the land, casting a radiant glow that fills the entire Braj region with a fresh charm and spiritual splendor. [2]Whoever catches a glimpse of Śrī Rādhā’s sacred footprints at their threshold becomes overwhelmed, surrendering their body, mind, and soul at Her feet; Her beauty stuns the entire town. [3]People are amazed and wonder — what exactly is this beauty? Is it the embodiment of bliss? The essence of peace? Or the aura that dispels darkness (tam‑harinī ābhā)? Some say, “She is Pārvatī”; others say, “She is Indumā (the moon goddess)”; some believe, “She is Lakṣmī”; but in truth, She is none other than the ultimate pinnacle of beauty — Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]

title: Madana Nada Taramgai - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)
sanskrit_text: Madana Nada Taramgairullasangopanari Hrridayachilachimanamamisham Samjihirshu.Brajapatitanayaravyo Dhivara Praudha Vamshi Kara Hita Mapi Vadityanta Tatrastu Vasa.- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)May I reside in the very Govardhan where Shri Krishna, the son of Nand, held His flute in His lotus hands and played its sweet melody, captivating the hearts of the beautiful cowherd maidens, overwhelmed with ecstatic waves of divine love.

title: Jake Aganit Gunan Ko Gavat Ved Richan - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)
sanskrit_text: Jaake Aganit Gunan Ko, Gaavat Ved Richan.Daari Ke, Gaari Sunan, Soi Chhedat Sakhiyan.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)Lord Shri Krishna, whose countless divine virtues are sung tirelessly by the four Vedas, that same supreme personality, in the land of Braj, considers it his highest fortune to mischievously tease the gopis and then be scolded by them with playful taunts like “Dārī ke!”.

title: Dhenu Duhat Mohan Thage - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohananandashtak (4)
sanskrit_text: Dhenu Duhat Mohan Thage, Radha Roop Nihar.Parat Dohani Tain Nikasi, Aendibaendi Dhaar.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohananandashtak (4)While milking the cow, the moment Krishna beholds Shri Radha’s divine form, He becomes so entranced that the milk twists here and there instead of going directly into the bucket.

title: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)
sanskrit_text: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai Radhabhidhayai Nikhilashrayayai.Sakridgrinantastavanamaye Vai Te Twam Gatim Yantibhavpramuktah.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)I bow again and again to the one who is supreme among all, beyond whom nothing exists, whose name is Radha, and who is the shelter of all beings. Whoever remembers Her name even once surely becomes free from the bonds of worldly existence and attains Her supreme abode.

title: Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru-Pati Laagi Bhoomi,Bhoomi-Pati Ses-Kol Kachh Neer Chaari Saun.Dig-Pati Laagi Dig-Palan Ke Haath Hathi,Sur-Pati Laagi Sur-Paal Chatradhaari Saun.Daan-Pati Karan Karan Pati Laagi Bali,Bali-Pati Laagi Kailaas Ke Vihaari Saun.Teenon Lok-Pati Braj-Pati Sau Laagi Hai,Braj-Pati Pati Laagi Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Saun.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)Mighty Himalaya bows to Mount Meru, which rests humbly upon the Earth; Earth itself stands upheld by Śeṣanāga, Varāha, Kūrma, and the oceanic depths — none stands alone. [1]The ten directions are ruled by guardians like Indra, Yama, and Varuṇa — even Indra, King of heaven, bows to higher powers beyond. [2]Even the generous Karṇa and noble King Bali serve under the lordship of Mahādev, Lord Śiva. [3]Yet Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva — the triad of creation, preservation, and destruction — are under the authority of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa of Vraja; and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself is under the command of Vṛṣabhānu‑nandinī, Śrī Rādhāraṇī. [4]

title: Jayati Jayati Radha Prema - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)
sanskrit_text: jayati jayati rādhā premasārairagādhā, jayati jayati kṛṣṇastadbhasāpāratṛṣṇaḥ jayati jayati vṛndaṃ satsakhīnāṃ dvayaikyaṃ, jayati jayati vṛndākānanaṃ tatsvadhāma- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)Glory, glory to Radha, a fathomless ocean of the essence of divine love! Glory, glory to Krishna, who is endlessly thirsty for the nectar of Radha-rasa! Glory, glory to their Sakhis that yearn for the union of this divine couple! title: Shyam Batayo Nain Mein - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)
sanskrit_text: Syam Batayo Nain Mein, Rahi Samujhi Sukunwari.Charan Lagyo Jab Kahayou Tab, Harshi Laal Nihari.- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)Shri Krishna pleaded to the sulking Shri Radha through His longing eyes, and She silently acknowledged His plea. But when He placed His head at Her lotus feet in deep humility, Her heart melted, and She was fully pleased.

title: Tum Mere They Rahoge Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)
sanskrit_text: Tum Mere They Rahoge, Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar.Adham Udharan Naath Puni, Kaahe Mohin Bisar.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)O Shri Krishna! title: Vrindavan Vriksha Hain Ki Parijat - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (6)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Vrindavan-Vriksha Hain Ki Paarijat Nandan Ke,Vrindavan-Shakha Ya Prem-Anjan-Shalaka Hain.Vrindavan-Raj Ya Rajat Renu-Raj Rahi,Vrindavan Path Hain Ki Prem-Puri-Naka Hain.Vrindavan-Kunj Ya Indra-Bhavan Shobhit Hain,Vrindavan-Dham Ya Niketan Prabha Ka Hain.Vrindavan-Phool Hain Ki Taravali Utari Ye,Vrindavan-Pat Hain Ki Prem Ki Pataka Hain.- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (6)Are these trees of Vṛndāvan or celestial Pārijāta trees in disguise?Are these branches, or wands touched with the collyrium of divine love? [1]Are these grains of Vṛndāvan’s dust, or shining pearls of purest silver scattered upon the earth?Are these pathways or the very gateways into the realm of divine love? [2]Are these bowers of Vṛndāvan, or dwellings resplendent beyond even Indra’s celestial palaces?Is this land just Vṛndāvan, or the very embodiment of beauty and divine radiance? [3]Are these flowers, or garlands of stars falling from the cosmos with divine fragrance?Are these Vṛndāvan’s leaves or fluttering flags of divine love? [4]

title: अहु राधे वृषभानु की - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (81)
sanskrit_text:
अहु राधे वृषभानु की, कुँवरी किसोरी बाल।
थोरी बै भौरीहि में, मोहे मोहन लाल॥
- श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (81)
english_text:
ahu radhe vrishabhanu kee, kunvaree kisoree bal.
thoree bai bhaureehi men, mohe mohan lal..
- shree bhatt devachary, yugal shatak (81)

title: Mohan Tadag Bag Phool Phal Mohan Hain - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (14)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Mohan Tadag Bag Phool Phal Mohan Hain,Mohan Gaay Giri Govardhan Lalam Hai. [1]Mohan Man Mohan Dhar Bahai Yamuna Ki,Mohan Madhupuri Mohan Nand Gram Hai. [2]Mohan Hain Gopijan Gwal Bal Mohan Hain,Mohan Shri Radha Aur Mohan Shri Shyam Hai. [3]Mohan Hain Lata Pata Kunj Sab Mohan Hain,Mohan Swaroop Yah Vrindavan Dham Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (14)The enchanting lakes, blooming gardens, and their fruits and flowers — all captivate the heart; the gentle cows, the majestic Govardhan Hill — everything in this sacred land is enchanting. [1]The flowing waters of Yamunā hold an irresistible charm. Mathurā and Nandgaon all radiate divine enchantment. [2]The Gopīs and the young cowherd boys embody divine enchantment. Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Śyām Themselves are the very essence of this divine charm. [3]Vines, leaves, and every kuñj are enchanting, for the entire land of Vṛndāvan is an embodiment of divine enchantment, a manifestation of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself. [4]

title: Jog Jagy Jap Tap Teerath Gavan Vrat - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (105)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jog Jagy Jap Tap Teerath Gavan Vrat,Kabahun Na Haridas Shravan Katha Kari. [1]Bhramana Bhramayau Maya Moh Mad Liptaayau,Vrithan Jag Baadan Mein Umar Bita Kari. [2]Lal Balbir Mati Heen Main Malin Peen,Sewa Rasikan Tanhoon Ki Nahin Ja Kari. [3]Krishn Ali Ju Ki Kripa Drishti Bar Paay Paay,Radha Thakurayan Ke Paayan Ki Chaakari. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (105)Neither did I perform yogic practices, sacrifices, chanting, austerities, or pilgrimages, nor did I ever listen to the sacred stories of Lord Hari. [1]Wandering aimlessly, entangled in illusion, bound by attachment and ego, I wasted my whole life in useless worldly debates. [2]Foolish, impure, and steeped in sorrow, not even once did I serve the true rasika devotees. [3]Yet by the mere glimpse of grace from Kṛṣṇa Ali Jū, my beloved Gurudev, I have been blessed to become a humble maidservant at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Thākuraṇī. [4]

title: Shakti Nahi Dhruv Si Akhand Tap Kaise Karun - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (76)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Shakti Nahi Dhruv Si Akhand Tap Kaise Karun,Bhakti Na Prahlad Si Ram Ram Kehne Ki. [1]Ambarish Tuly Dridh Vrat Ka Niyam Nahi,Harishchandra Si Na Dridhata Kasht Sahne Ki. [2]Moradhwaj Jaisa Mujhe Dharm Ka Bhi Prem Nahi,Shraddha Nahi Sur Si Prem-Path Gahne Ki. [3]Aradhana Na Aur Koi Kar Sakta Nath,Sadhana Ek Meri Vrindavan Rahne Ki. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (76)O Lord! I do not possess the strength like Dhruva to perform unwavering penance,Nor do I have the devotion like Prahlāda to chant Your holy name constantly. [1]I cannot uphold vows with the firmness of King Ambarīṣa,Nor do I have the endurance like Harishchandra to bear immense hardships. [2]I lack the love for righteousness like Moradhwaj,Nor do I have the unwavering faith like Śrī Sūrdās in this path of divine love. [3]O Lord! I am incapable of performing any other spiritual practice,My only true sādhanā is to reside in Śrī Vṛndāvan Dham. [4]

title: Phoole Hain Palaas Aas Paas - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Basant Ritu (26)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitta)Phoole Hain Palaas Aas Paas Ban Baagan Mein,Madhur Madhur Ter Kokoila Lagai Hai. [1]Gunjat Madhur Punj Kunj Kunjan Mein,Sheetal Sugandh Mand Pavan Suhai Hai. [2]‘Lal Balveer’ Bas Baalam Videsh Rahe,Ko Kare Sahay Peer Main Ko Savai Hai. [3]Pathik Praveen Pyare Itni Kripa Karike,Kahiyo Jaay Kant Soun Basant Ritu Aai Hai. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Basant Ritu (26)The Pālāś trees have blossomed across the forests and gardens, and the cuckoo sings a sweet melody. [1]The humming of bees fills the bowers, and the gentle, fragrant breeze brings joy. [2]Lāl Balveer says, “If the beloved is far away in a distant land, who will ease this sorrow, as my pain only grows?” [3]O dear traveler, have mercy and convey this message; tell my beloved Śyāmasundara that the season of spring has arrived!. [4]

title: Naval Basant Naval Shri Vrindavan - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (84)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Nav Kishor Nav Nagari, Nav Sab Saunjaru Saaj.Nav Vrindavan Nav Kusum, Nav Basant Rituraj.(Pad) [Iktal, Raag-Basant]Naval Basant Naval Shri Vrindavan, Naval Hi Phule Phool.Naval Hi Kanh Naval Sab Gopi, Nirat Tat Ekai Tool. [1]Naval Hi Sashi Jwadi Kunkuma, Naval Hi Basan Amool.Naval Hi Chhint Bani Kesar Ki, Mentat Manmath Sool. [2]Naval Gulal Udai Rang Booka, Naval Pavan Kai Jhool.Naval Hi Baje Bajat Shri Bhatt, Kalindi Ke Kool. [3]- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (84)(Doha)Ever-new is ‘Kishor’ (Shri Krishna), ever-new is ‘Nagari’ (Shri Radha), everything is adorned in fresh splendor.Ever-new is Vrindavan, ever-new are the blossoms, and ever-new is the king of seasons, spring (Basant).(Pada)As Basant, the king of seasons, arrives, Shri Vrindavan glows with ever-new splendor, its blossoming flowers brimming with freshness.Ever-youthful is Krishna, and ever-youthful are all the gopis, among whom Shri Vrishabhanu Nandini (Sri Radha) gracefully dances with Lalji in perfect harmony. [1]The freshness of spring is further enhanced by the newly blossomed branches of fragrant sandalwood trees. Ever-new priceless garments are adorned with fresh saffron sprays, and the ever-radiant gopis, who wear these divine attires, appear ever-new, soothing the burning pangs of love. [2]Ever-new colors of gulala (scented powder), fresh abira, and vibrant roli (vermilion) are playfully tossed into the air. Ever-fresh is the breeze swaying gently, ever-fresh is the music played in this king of seasons, Basant, on the banks of the Yamuna, says Shri Bhata Devacharya. [3]

title: Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (12)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Kalit Kunj Abhiraam Hai. [1]Swarg Mein Kahaan Bheer Gopi Gaay Gwaal Waale Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Pulin Yamuna Lalaam Hai. [2]Swarg Mein Saras Braj Bhasha Ka Prachaar Kahaan,Swarg Mein Kahaan Makhhan Chor Ghanashyam Hai. [3]Swarg Mein Amit Sukh Itna Aapaar Kahaan,Swarg Se Bhi Shreshth Yah Vrindavan Dhaam Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (12)Where can one hear the sweet melody of ‘Rādhe Rādhe’ in heaven?Where in heaven are those enchanting bowers and forests? [1]Where can one see the crowds of gopīs, cows, and cowherds in heaven?Where in heaven are the beautiful banks of the Yamunā? [2]Where in heaven is such a sweet and nectar‑like Brajbhāṣā spoken?Where in heaven can one find the butter‑thief (Ghanshyām) Śrī Kṛṣṇa? [3]Where in heaven is such infinite and unparalleled bliss found?Ḍaṃḍī Swāmī Śrī Hare Krishṇānand Saraswatī Jī says that this Vṛndāvan Dham is far superior to heaven itself. [4]

title: Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrinda Sada - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Sri Radha Shatak (18)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrind Sada Vande Tumhe,Anand Ke Kande Nandanandai Sang Lijiye. [1]Teen Lok Jeevan Ke Sokan Ki Harn,Prasanna Mukh Pankaj Son Charan Saran Dijiye. [2]Nikunj Bhu Vilasini Prakashani Hau Gyan Ki,Vijendra Bhan Nandani Araj Suni Lijiye. [3]Kahat Bar Bar Main Tihare Darbar Mein,‘Sulal Balbir’ Pai Kripa Kataksh Kijiye. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (18)All sages bow at Your lotus feet; You are the eternal consort of Braj’s prince, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the source of bliss. [1]You are the remover of sorrows across the three worlds, with a cheerful face blooming like a lotus. Kindly grant me refuge at Your lotus feet. [2]You, who delight in the love‑plays of the Nikunj forest, are the illuminator of divine wisdom and the daughter of King Vṛṣabhānu, the noblest of kings. Please graciously hear my prayer. [3]Śrī Lāl Balbir says, “I repeatedly offer my plea to Your court — cast Your merciful glance upon me”. [4]

title: Kah Deta Jhat Jeev Se - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (42)
sanskrit_text: Kah Deta Jhat Jeev Se, Rat Tu Radhe Shyam.Swayam Kahin Aata Nikal, Man Tu Bada Haram.- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (42)O mind, you quickly compel the tongue to chant ‘Radhe Shyam,’ yet you remain deceitful and cunning, wandering aimlessly elsewhere on your own.

title: Kechidbhajanti Krritino Girijamathanye - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)
sanskrit_text: kecidbhajanti kṛtino girijāmathānyesevanti bhargamapare divasādhināthaṃeke gaṇādhipa surādhipa śaṃkarādīnsevantvahaṃ girivaraṃ śaraṇaṃ brajāmi- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)Some find their devotion in worshiping Girija Devi (Parvati), others bow to Lord Shiva. Some serve Surya Bhagwan (the Sun God), while others revere Lord Ganesha, Indra, or Shankar Ji. Let each follow their chosen deity; as for me, my heart and faith rest solely in the refuge of Shri Govardhan Ji.

title: Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par,Deta Dikhalayi Jahan Khara Jal Koop Hai. [1]Gari De Bolte Brajbasi Sab Aapas Mein,Anna Phal Heen Dhara Khaadar Kuroop Hai. [2]Paakar Ke Chhaak Chhachh Gauyen Charata Phire,Phir Bhi Banaya Use Svarg Se Anoop Hai. [3]Aisa Jo Manmauji Mast Thakur Triloki Ka,Rakshak Hamara Vahi Vrindavan Bhoop Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)The land is filled with thorny Karīla trees, and its wells hold only salty water. [1]Where the Brajvāsīs converse with each other in abusive language, the land itself remains barren, devoid of crops and fruits, and steeped in desolation. [2]Yet, Śrī Kṛṣṇa roams through this land, drinking buttermilk and grazing cows, transforming Vṛndāvan into a place more beautiful than heaven itself. [3]That rapturous Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the ruler of the three worlds, is the king of Vṛndāvan and our beloved protector. [4]

title: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada Nandanandan Brajchand - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)
sanskrit_text: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada, Nandanandan Brajchand.Radhasat Baranat Karat, Phir Na Paron Bhav-Phand.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)I humbly bow to the lotus feet of Sri Krishna, the moon of Braj and beloved son of Nanda, whose grace has granted me the ability to compose “Radha Shat” (Radha Sudha Shatak). May I be forever liberated from the bondage of worldly existence.

title: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)
sanskrit_text: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai, Jugul Kamalpag Teer.Jyon Pyaase Ki Laalsa, Nirmal Seetal Neer.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)When will my mind become devoted to the lotus feet of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn, with the same intensity that a thirsty person longs for cool and pure water?

title: मेरी टेर सुनो सुकुमारी - श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
sanskrit_text:
मेरी टेर सुनो सुकुमारी। [1]
अखिल लोक चूड़ामणि सुन्दर मनमोहन की प्यारी॥ [2]
परम उदार दयानिधि नागरि दीनन ओर निहारी। [3]
दासी जानि कीजिये स्वामिनि महल टहल अधिकारी॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
english_text:
meree ter suno sukumaree. [1]
akhil lok chooड़amani sundar manamohan kee pyaree.. [2]
param udar dayanidhi nagari deenan or niharee. [3]
dasee jani keejiye svamini mahal tahal adhikaree.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer, vrindavan shatak (53)

sanskrit_text:

sab sadhan sampann kahn, puchhat sab snsar.
sadhanaheen prapann kahn, puchhat nndakumar..

title: अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
sanskrit_text:
अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य गुरुशास्त्राविद्वद्वर्यैः।
त्वयि वृन्दावन! आप वासायेन्द्रियवशमप्यतो न हि त्यज माम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
english_text:
atisahasamacharitn virudhy gurushastravidvadvaryaih.
tvayi vrindavan! aap vasayendriyavashamapyato n hi tyaj mam..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.14)

title: अपि सर्वधर्महीनः सर्वकुकर्मावलेश्च निर्माता - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.13)
sanskrit_text:

english_text:

बंदत रहैं हमेस, श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि पद॥

title: दोऊ मिल करत भामती बतियाँ - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (75)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ, ताल चम्पक)
दोऊ मिल करत भामती बतियाँ। [1]
मदन गोपाल कुँवर राधे संग नखमनि अंक लिखत उर छतियाँ॥ [2]
तेसी छिरक रही उजियारी पून्यो चंद शरद की रतियाँ। [3]
केल रूप यह यमुना श्री भट वृन्दावन फूल्यो बहु भतियाँ॥ [4]
- श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (75)
english_text:
(rag vihagarau, tal champaka)
dooo mil karat bhamatee batiyan. [1]
madan gopal kunvar radhe sng nakhamani ank likhat ur chhatiyan.. [2]
tesee chhirak rahee ujiyaree poonyo chnd sharad kee ratiyan. [3]
kel roop yah yamuna shree bhat vrindavan foolyo bahu bhatiyan.. [4]
- shree bhatt devachary, yugal shatak (75)

title: श्री वृषभानु सुता पद पंकज - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद,श्रीराधा शतक (74)
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
श्री वृषभानु सुता पद पंकज मेरी, सदां यह जीवन मूर है। [1]
याही के नाम सो ध्यान रहै, नित जाकें रटे जग कंटक दूर हैं॥ [2]
श्रीवनराज निवास दियो, जिन और दियो सुख हू भरपूर है। [3]
याकौं बिसार जो औरै भजौं, 'बलबीर' जू जानिये तौ मुख धूर है॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद,श्रीराधा शतक (74)
english_text:
(savaiya)
shree vrishabhanu suta pad pnkaj meree, sadan yah jeevan moor hai. [1]
yahee ke nam so dhyan rahai, nit jaken rate jag kntak door hain.. [2]
shreevanaraj nivas diyo, jin aur diyo sukh hoo bharapoor hai. [3]
yakaun bisar jo aurai bhajaun, 'balabeer' joo janiye tau mukh dhoor hai.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod,shreeradha shatak (74)

(savaiya)

title: किं करोम्यहमुन्मत्तो यत् किंचत प्रलपाम्यलम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.33)
sanskrit_text:
किं करोम्यहमुन्मत्तो यत् किंचत प्रलपाम्यलम्।
ज्ञान-भक्ति-विरक्त्यादि व्यार्थं वृन्दावनं विना॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.33)
english_text:
kin karomyahamunmatto yat kinchat pralapamyalam.
jnyana-bhakti-viraktyadi vyarthn vrindavann vina..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (4.33)
english_translation:
kin karomyahamunmatto yat kinchat pralapamyalam.
jnyana-bhakti-viraktyadi vyarthn vrindavann vina..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (4.33)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वृषभानु कुमारि - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (2)
sanskrit_text:
श्री वृषभानु कुमारि, परम उदार कृपाल तुम।
दासी मोहि बिचारि, टहल महल की दीजिये॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (2)
english_text:
shree vrishabhanu kumari, param udar kripal tum.
dasee mohi bichari, tahal mahal kee deejiye..
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod, shreeradha shatak (2)
english_translation:
shree vrishabhanu kumari, param udar kripal tum.
dasee mohi bichari, tahal mahal kee deejiye..
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod, shreeradha shatak (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा-चरण-रणन्मणिनूपुरमूकीकृतां हरेर्मुरलीम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.30)
sanskrit_text:
राधा-चरण-रणन्मणिनूपुरमूकीकृतां हरेर्मुरलीम्।
विफलित-तत्तत्फुत्कृतिमखिलसखीसार्थहासिनीं स्मरत॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.30)
english_text:
radha-charana-rananmaninoopuramookeekritan harermuraleem.
vifalita-tattatfutkritimakhilasakheesarthahasineen smarat..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.30)
english_translation:
radha-charana-rananmaninoopuramookeekritan harermuraleem.
vifalita-tattatfutkritimakhilasakheesarthahasineen smarat..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.30)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यशोभिः पूरिता आशा कृतं विश्वानुरंजनम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.32)
sanskrit_text:
यशोभिः पूरिता आशा कृतं विश्वानुरंजनम्।
हा हन्त दिड् मात्रमपि नेक्षे वृन्दावनेशयोः॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.32)
english_text:
yashobhih poorita aasha kritn vishvanurnjanam.
ha hant did matramapi nekshe vrindavaneshayoh..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (4.32)
english_translation:
yashobhih poorita aasha kritn vishvanurnjanam.
ha hant did matramapi nekshe vrindavaneshayoh..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (4.32)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आई तुमरे द्वार श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि जू - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, श्रीराधा शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
आई तुमरे द्वार, श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि जू।
चेरी हौं सुकमार, चरन सरन मैं राखीये॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, श्रीराधा शतक (1)
english_text:
aaee tumare dvar, shreevrishabhanu kumari joo.
cheree haun sukamar, charan saran main rakheeye..
- shree lal balabeer jee, shreeradha shatak (1)
english_translation:
aaee tumare dvar, shreevrishabhanu kumari joo.
cheree haun sukamar, charan saran main rakheeye..
- shree lal balabeer jee, shreeradha shatak (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यावद्राधापदनखमणि चन्द्रिका नाविरास्ते - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (13.2)
sanskrit_text:
यावद्राधापदनखमणि चन्द्रिका नाविरास्ते तावद् वृन्दावनभुवि मुदं नैति चेतश्चकोरी।
यावद वृन्दावनभुवि भवेन्नापि निष्ठा गरिष्ठा तावत् राधाचरणकरुणा नैव तादृश्युदेति॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (13.2)
english_text:
yavadradhapadanakhamani chandrika naviraste tavad vrindavanabhuvi mudn naiti chetashchakoree.
yavad vrindavanabhuvi bhavennapi nishtha garishtha tavat radhacharanakaruna naiv tadrishyudeti..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (13.2)
english_translation:
yavadradhapadanakhamani chandrika naviraste tavad vrindavanabhuvi mudn naiti chetashchakoree.
yavad vrindavanabhuvi bhavennapi nishtha garishtha tavat radhacharanakaruna naiv tadrishyudeti..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (13.2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: त्रैलोक्य मोहिनीभिर्नवतरुणीभिर्महाविदग्धाभिः - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.11)
sanskrit_text:
त्रैलोक्य मोहिनीभिर्नवतरुणीभिर्महाविदग्धाभिः।
आराध्यां स्मर वृन्दाविपिने सर्वोज्ज्वलां राधाम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.11)
english_text:
trailoky mohineebhirnavataruneebhirmahavidagdhabhih.
aaradhyan smar vrindavipine sarvojjvalan radham..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.11)
english_translation:
trailoky mohineebhirnavataruneebhirmahavidagdhabhih.
aaradhyan smar vrindavipine sarvojjvalan radham..

title: राधे तेरे प्रेम की कापै कहि आवे - श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (29)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
मन बच कर्म दुर्गम सदा, ताहि व चरण छुबात।
राधे तेरे प्रेम की, कहि आवत नहिं बात॥
english_text:
(doha)
man bach karm durgam sada, tahi v charan chhubat.
radhe tere prem kee, kahi aavat nahin bat..
english_translation:
(doha)

radhe tere prem kee, kahi aavat nahin bat..
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावनमनुविन्दाम्यहमपि देहं - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.53)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावनमनुविन्दाम्यहमपि देहं श्वशूकरादीनाम्।
न पुनः परत्र सच्चित् सुखमयमपि॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.53)
english_text:
vrindavanamanuvindamyahamapi dehn shvashookaradeenam.
n punh paratr sachchit sukhamayamapi..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (3.53)
english_translation:
vrindavanamanuvindamyahamapi dehn shvashookaradeenam.
n punh paratr sachchit sukhamayamapi..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (3.53)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीराधे राधे रटौं - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (2)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीराधे राधे रटौं, राधे कौ उर ध्यान।
मम कुल देवी देवता, राधा रमण सुजान॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (2)
english_text:
shreeradhe radhe rataun, radhe kau ur dhyan.
mam kul devee devata, radha raman sujan..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (2)
english_translation:
shreeradhe radhe rataun, radhe kau ur dhyan.
mam kul devee devata, radha raman sujan..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वरमिह वृन्दारण्ये सुवराकी मदनमोहनद्वारि - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.67 )
sanskrit_text:
वरमिह वृन्दारण्ये सुवराकी मदनमोहनद्वारि।
अपि सरमापि रमाप्रियसख्यपि नान्यत्र नो रमापि स्याम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.67 )
english_text:
varamih vrindaranye suvarakee madanamohanadvari.
api saramapi ramapriyasakhyapi nanyatr no ramapi syam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (2.67 )
english_translation:
varamih vrindaranye suvarakee madanamohanadvari.
api saramapi ramapriyasakhyapi nanyatr no ramapi syam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (2.67 )
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गोरी मन भोरी अहो - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
गोरी मन भोरी अहो, श्रीराधे सुख रास।
चरन कमल बंदन करौं, पुजवौ जन की आस॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (1)
english_text:
goree man bhoree aho, shreeradhe sukh ras.
charan kamal bndan karaun, pujavau jan kee aas..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (1)
english_translation:
goree man bhoree aho, shreeradhe sukh ras.
charan kamal bndan karaun, pujavau jan kee aas..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: त्यक्त्वा वृन्दावनमिदमहो चेद्बहिर्यासि - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.67 )
sanskrit_text:
त्यक्त्वा वृन्दावनमिदमहो चेद्बहिर्यासि नूनंक्षिप्त्वा कल्पद्रुमवरवनं हन्त शाखोटमेषि।
हित्वा वृन्दावन-रसकथामन्यवार्ता-रुचिश्चेज्ज्ञातं क्षिप्त्वा परमममृतं भोक्तुमिच्छुः श्वविष्ठाम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.67 )
english_text:
tyaktva vrindavanamidamaho chedbahiryasi noonnkshiptva kalpadrumavaravann hant shakhotameshi.
hitva vrindavana-rasakathamanyavarta-ruchishchejjnyatn kshiptva paramamamritn bhoktumichchhuh shvavishtham..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.67 )
english_translation:
tyaktva vrindavanamidamaho chedbahiryasi noonnkshiptva kalpadrumavaravann hant shakhotameshi.
hitva vrindavana-rasakathamanyavarta-ruchishchejjnyatn kshiptva paramamamritn bhoktumichchhuh shvavishtham..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.67 )
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधा राधा रटौ, त्याग जगत की आस - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (10)
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधा राधा रटौ, त्याग जगत की आस।
ब्रज वीथिन विचरत रहौ, कर वृन्दावन वास॥ [1]
कर वृन्दावनन वास रसिकजन संगति कीजै।
प्रेम पंथ मन ढरौ त्याग विष अमृत पीजै॥ [2]
कहैं 'लाल बलबीर' होय आनन्द अगाधा।
निश्चै करिके चित्त कहौ श्रीराधा राधा॥ [3]
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (10)
english_text:
shree radha radha ratau, tyag jagat kee aas.
braj veethin vicharat rahau, kar vrindavan vas.. [1]
kar vrindavanan vas rasikajan sngati keejai.
prem pnth man dharau tyag vish amrit peejai.. [2]
kahain 'lal balabeer' hoy aanand agadha.
nishchai karike chitt kahau shreeradha radha.. [3]
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod, vrindavan shatak (10)
english_translation:
shree radha radha ratau, tyag jagat kee aas.
braj veethin vicharat rahau, kar vrindavan vas.. [1]
kar vrindavanan vas rasikajan sngati keejai.
prem pnth man dharau tyag vish amrit peejai.. [2]

nishchai karike chitt kahau shreeradha radha.. [3]
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod, vrindavan shatak (10)

title: त्वयाकण्ठं पीतं यदि परमपीयूषमपि - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.46)
sanskrit_text:
त्वयाकण्ठं पीतं यदि परमपीयूषमपि कि ततो यद्युर्वश्याः स्तनलयुगलमाश्लेषि किमतः।
यदि ब्रह्मानन्दामृतमपि समास्वादि किमतो यतस्थुत्कृत्येदं व्यसृजदपि वृन्दानतृणम॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.46)
english_text:
tvayakanthn peetn yadi paramapeeyooshamapi ki tato yadyurvashyah stanalayugalamashleshi kimath.
yadi brahmanandamritamapi samasvadi kimato yatasthutkrityedn vyasrijadapi vrindanatrinam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (3.46)
english_translation:
tvayakanthn peetn yadi paramapeeyooshamapi ki tato yadyurvashyah stanalayugalamashleshi kimath.
yadi brahmanandamritamapi samasvadi kimato yatasthutkrityedn vyasrijadapi vrindanatrinam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (3.46)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हीन हौं, अधीन हौं तिहारो ब्रज-साहिबनी! - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (50)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
हीन हौं, अधीन हौं तिहारो ब्रज-साहिबनी!
हिय में मलीन करुना की कोर ढरिए। [1]
भारी भवसागर में बोरत बचायौ मोहिं,
काम क्रोध लोभ मोह लागे सब अरिए॥ [2]
बुरो-भलो, जैसो-तैसो, तेरे द्वार पर्यौ हौं तौं,
मेरे गुन-औगुन तूं मन में न धरिए। [3]
कीरति-किसोरी, वृषभानु की दुहाई तोंहिं,
लच्छ-लच्छ भाँति सों 'हठी' को पच्छ करिए॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (50)
english_text:
(kavitta)
heen haun, adheen haun tiharo braja-sahibanee!
hiy men maleen karuna kee kor dharie. [1]
bharee bhavasagar men borat bachayau mohin,
kam krodh lobh moh lage sab arie.. [2]
buro-bhalo, jaiso-taiso, tere dvar paryau haun taun,
mere guna-augun toon man men n dharie. [3]
keerati-kisoree, vrishabhanu kee duhaee tonhin,
lachchha-lachchh bhanti son 'hathee' ko pachchh karie.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (50)
english_translation:
(kavitta)
heen haun, adheen haun tiharo braja-sahibanee!
hiy men maleen karuna kee kor dharie. [1]
bharee bhavasagar men borat bachayau mohin,
kam krodh lobh moh lage sab arie.. [2]
buro-bhalo, jaiso-taiso, tere dvar paryau haun taun,
mere guna-augun toon man men n dharie. [3]
keerati-kisoree, vrishabhanu kee duhaee tonhin,
lachchha-lachchh bhanti son 'hathee' ko pachchh karie.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (50)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मोरपखा गर गुन्ज की माल - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (35)
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
मोरपखा गर गुन्ज की माल, किये नव भेष बड़ी छबि छाई। [1]
पीतपटी दुपटी कटी में, लपटी लकुटी हठी मो मन भाई॥ [2]
छुटी लटैं डुलै कुण्डल कान, बजै मुरली धुनि मन्द सुहाई। [3]
कोटिन काम गुलाम भये, जब कान्ह ह्वै भानलली बनि आई॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (35)
english_text:
(savaiya)
morapakha gar gunj kee mal, kiye nav bhesh baड़ee chhabi chhaee. [1]
peetapatee dupatee katee men, lapatee lakutee hathee mo man bhaee.. [2]
chhutee latain dulai kundal kan, bajai muralee dhuni mand suhaee. [3]
kotin kam gulam bhaye, jab kanh hvai bhanalalee bani aaee.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (35)

title: भो भो धन्य शिरोमर्णे! भगवतः - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृंदावन महिमामृत (6.5)
sanskrit_text:
भो भो धन्य शिरोमर्णे! भगवतः पादाम्बुजैकांतिक प्रेम्णश्चेत् परमं रहस्यमतिदुष्प्राप्यं च संप्रेप्स्यसि।
तत्त्वं नित्यविहारमन्दिररमिदं श्रीराधिकाकृष्णयो-राद्य-स्वाद्यरसात्मकाखिलसमृद्ध्याऽघ्यास्स्व वृन्दावनम्॥

- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (6.5)

title: सबै शक्ति हैं नाम में - जगद्गुरु कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (18)
sanskrit_text:
सबै शक्ति हैं नाम में, मन! निशिदिन आराध।
पै नहिँ शक्तिन लाभ तिन, किये नाम अपराध॥
- जगद्गुरु कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (18)
english_text:

title: यत्राभङ्गस्मरविलसितैः क्रीडतो दम्पती - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृंदावन महिमामृत (1.53)
sanskrit_text:

सान्द्रानन्दोन्मदरसमहासिन्धुसंमज्जिताली वृन्दौ वृन्दावनमिह महादुर्भगा नाश्रयन्ते॥

sanskrit_text:

title: कोमल कमल हू सों गहरे गुलाबन सों - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री राधा शतक (06)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कोमल कमल हू सों गहरे गुलाबन सों, 
ललित रसाल पत्र आभा के हरन हैं। [1]
लाल हैं गुलाल गुंज हिंगुर सिंदुर बिंब, 
ये कहा बिचारे रंक समता करन हैं॥ [2]
'लाल बलबीर' उर करत बिचार चारु, 
उपमा हजारन की सुषमा दरन हैं। [3]
रसिक जनन धन ये ही हैं अगिन सर्व, 
आनंद करन राधारानी के चरन हैं॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री राधा शतक (06)
english_text:
(kavitta)
komal kamal hoo son gahare gulaban son, 
lalit rasal patr aabha ke haran hain. [1]
lal hain gulal gunj hingur sindur binb, 
ye kaha bichare rnk samata karan hain.. [2]
'lal balabeer' ur karat bichar charu, 
upama hajaran kee sushama daran hain. [3]
rasik janan dhan ye hee hain agin sarv, 
aannd karan radharanee ke charan hain.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer, braj binod, shree radha shatak (06)
english_translation:

title: श्री राधे श्रुतिभिर्बुधैर्भगवताप्यामृग्यसद्वैभवे
sanskrit_text: श्री राधे श्रुतिभिर्बुधैर्भगवताप्यामृग्यसद्वैभवे स्वस्तोत्रं स्वकृपात एव सहजो योग्योप्यहं कारितः।पद्येनैव सदापराधिनि महन्मार्गं विरुध्य त्वदेकाशे स्नेहजलाकुलाक्षि किमपि प्रीतिं प्रसादीकुरु॥
english_text: shree radhe shrutibhirbudhairbhagavatapyamrigyasadvaibhave svastotrn svakripat ev sahajo yogyopyahn karith.padyenaiv sadaparadhini mahanmargn virudhy tvadekashe snehajalakulakshi kimapi preetin prasadeekuru..
english_translation: shree radhe shrutibhirbudhairbhagavatapyamrigyasadvaibhave svastotrn svakripat ev sahajo yogyopyahn karith.padyenaiv sadaparadhini mahanmargn virudhy tvadekashe snehajalakulakshi kimapi preetin prasadeekuru..
content_text:
श्री राधे श्रुतिभिर्बुधैर्भगवताप्यामृग्यसद्वैभवे स्वस्तोत्रं स्वकृपात एव सहजो योग्योप्यहं कारितः।
पद्येनैव सदापराधिनि महन्मार्गं विरुध्य त्वदेकाशे स्नेहजलाकुलाक्षि किमपि प्रीतिं प्रसादीकुरु॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (269)
वेद, पण्डितगण तथा भगवान के द्वारा भी अन्वेषणीय (ढूँढ़े जाने योग्य) श्रेष्ठ वैभव वाली हे श्री राधे ! आपने अपनी कृपा के ही द्वारा पद्य रूप में अपने स्तोत्र (स्तुति ग्रंथ) की रचना में मुझे सहज (बिना प्रयास के) योग्य बना दिया। हे स्नेह जल से भीगे नेत्र वाली, महापुरुषों द्वारा प्रतिपादित मार्गों का विरोध करने वाले, सदा अपराध युक्त और एकमात्र आपकी आशा रखने वाले मुझे अपने अनिर्वचनीय प्रीति का प्रसाद दीजिए।
author: श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (269)

title: साँचो दास न कबहुँ चह - जगद्गुरू श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (15)

कीरति, कीरति कुँवरि की, कहि कहि थके गणेश।
दस सत मुख बरनन करत, पार न पावत शेष॥

title: नमो नमो वृषभानुजा - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (11)
sanskrit_text:
नमो नमो वृषभानुजा, नमो नमो सुखरास।
नमो नमो असरन सरन, मम उर करौ निवास॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (11)
english_text:
namo namo vrishabhanuja, namo namo sukharas.
namo namo asaran saran, mam ur karau nivas..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (11)
english_translation:
namo namo vrishabhanuja, namo namo sukharas.
namo namo asaran saran, mam ur karau nivas..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (11)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: डोलत फिरत मुख बोलत में राधे राधे - श्री लाल बलबीर, श्री राधा शतक (96)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
डोलत फिरत मुख बोलत में राधे राधे,
और जग जालन के ख्यालन सों हट रे। [1]
सोवत जागत मग जोवत में राधे राधे,
राधे रट राधे त्याग उर ते कपट रे॥[2]
'लाल बलबीर' धर धीर रट राधे राधे,
टरैं कोटि बाधे रट राधे झटपट रे। [3]
एरे मन मेरे चेत भूलिकें न हो अचेत,
राधे रट राधे रट राधे राधे रट रे॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री राधा शतक (96)
english_text:
(kavitta)
dolat firat mukh bolat men radhe radhe,
aur jag jalan ke khyalan son hat re. [1]
sovat jagat mag jovat men radhe radhe,
radhe rat radhe tyag ur te kapat re..[2]
'lal balabeer' dhar dheer rat radhe radhe,
tarain koti badhe rat radhe jhatapat re. [3]
ere man mere chet bhooliken n ho achet,
radhe rat radhe rat radhe radhe rat re.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer, braj binod, shree radha shatak (96)
english_translation:
(kavitta)

radhe rat radhe rat radhe radhe rat re.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer, braj binod, shree radha shatak (96)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अतर पुतायो चौक चन्दन लिपायो - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (10)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
अतर पुतायो चौक चन्दन लिपायो,
बिछी गिलाम गलीचन की पंगत प्रमान की। [1]
काली पीली हरी लाल झालरे झलक रहीं,
जैसे छविछाई चारू चाँदनी वितान की॥ [2]
झीनी श्वेत सारी जड़ी मोतिन किनारीदार,
फैली मुख आभा हठी राधे सुख दान की। [3]
नाह नेह नद्दी कर रमा रूप रद्दी कर,
बैठी आन गद्दी पर बेटी वृषभानु की॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (10)
english_text:
(kavitta)
atar putayo chauk chandan lipayo,
bichhee gilam galeechan kee pngat praman kee. [1]
kalee peelee haree lal jhalare jhalak raheen,
jaise chhavichhaee charoo chandanee vitan kee.. [2]
jheenee shvet saree jadaee motin kinareedar,
failee mukh aabha hathee radhe sukh dan kee. [3]
nah neh naddee kar rama roop raddee kar,
baithee aan gaddee par betee vrishabhanu kee.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (10)

title: मन ! मैं को मत छोड़ तू - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (31)
sanskrit_text:
मन ! मैं को मत छोड़ तू, दास जोड़ दे और।
मेरा भी रख साथ में, सो रसिकन सिरमौर॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (31)
english_text:
man ! main ko mat chhoड़ too, das joड़ de aur.
mera bhee rakh sath men, so rasikan siramaur..
- jagadguru shree kripalu jee maharaj, bhakti shatak (31)
english_translation:
man ! main ko mat chhoड़ too, das joड़ de aur.
mera bhee rakh sath men, so rasikan siramaur..
- jagadguru shree kripalu jee maharaj, bhakti shatak (31)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोमल विमल मंजु कंज के अरुण सोहैं - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (3)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कोमल विमल मंजु कंज के अरुण सोहैं,
लच्छन समेत शुभ शुद्ध कंदनी के हैं। [1]
हरी के मनालय निरालय निराकारन के,
भक्ति बरदायक बखाने छन्दनी के हैं॥ [2]
ध्यावत सुरेश शम्भु शेष औ गणेश खुले,
भाग अवनीके जहाँ मन्द परै नीके है। [3]
कटै जन फंदनीय द्वंदनीय हरिहर,
वंदनीय चरण वृषभानु नन्दनी के है॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (3)
english_text:
(kavitta)
komal vimal mnju knj ke arun sohain,
lachchhan samet shubh shuddh kndanee ke hain. [1]
haree ke manalay niralay nirakaran ke,
bhakti baradayak bakhane chhandanee ke hain.. [2]
dhyavat suresh shambhu shesh au ganesh khule,
bhag avaneeke jahan mand parai neeke hai. [3]
katai jan fndaneey dvndaneey harihar,
vndaneey charan vrishabhanu nandanee ke hai.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (3)
english_translation:

title: श्री बृषभानु-कुमारि के - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
श्री बृषभानु-कुमारि के, पग बंदौ कर जोर।
जे निसिबासर उर धरै, ब्रज बसि नंद-किसोर॥
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (1)
english_text:
shree brishabhanu-kumari ke, pag bndau kar jor.
je nisibasar ur dharai, braj basi nnda-kisor..
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (1)
english_translation:
shree brishabhanu-kumari ke, pag bndau kar jor.
je nisibasar ur dharai, braj basi nnda-kisor..
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अनन्तैश्चिज्ज्योत्स्ना-रसजलधिपूरस्तत इतो - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.83)
sanskrit_text:
अनन्तैश्चिज्ज्योत्स्ना-रसजलधिपूरस्तत इतो, वहद्भिर्गोलोकावधि सकलसंप्लावनकरम्।
अहो सर्वस्योपर्यतिविमल विस्तीर्णमधुर-स्फुरच्चन्द्रप्रायं स्फुरति मम वृन्दावनमिदम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.83)
english_text:
anantaishchijjyotsna-rasajaladhipoorastat ito, vahadbhirgolokavadhi sakalasnplavanakaram.
aho sarvasyoparyativimal visteernamadhura-sfurachchandraprayn sfurati mam vrindavanamidam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (4.83)
english_translation:

title: संतो, सेव्य हमारे श्रीपिय प्यारे - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (5)
sanskrit_text:
संतो, सेव्य हमारे श्रीपिय प्यारे, वृन्दाविपिन विलासी।
नंदनँदन वृषभानुनंदनी, चरन अनन्य उपासी॥ [1]
मत्त प्रणय बस सदा एकरस, बिबिध निकुंज निवासी।
श्रीभट जुगल बंशीबट सेवत, मूरति सब सुखरासी॥ [2]
- श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (5)
english_text:
snto, sevy hamare shreepiy pyare, vrindavipin vilasee.
nndanndan vrishabhanunndanee, charan anany upasee.. [1]
matt pranay bas sada ekaras, bibidh nikunj nivasee.
shreebhat jugal bnsheebat sevat, moorati sab sukharasee.. [2]
- shree bhatt devachary, yugal shatak (5)
english_translation:

title: रुददपि पितृमातृ-बन्धुपुत्रादिकमपहाय - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.82)
sanskrit_text:
रुददपि पितृमातृ-बन्धुपुत्रादिकमपहाय निशम्य नार्हदुक्तीः। 
हृदि परमकठोरतां दधानो द्रुतमवलोकय कृष्णकेलिकुञ्जम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.82)
english_text:
rudadapi pitrimatri-bandhuputradikamapahay nishamy narhadukteeh. 
hridi paramakathoratan dadhano drutamavalokay krishnakelikunyjam..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.82)

title: अज सिव सिद्ध सुरेश मुख - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (3)
sanskrit_text:
अज सिव सिद्ध सुरेश मुख, जपत रहत निसि जाम। 
बाधा जन की हरत है, राधा राधा नाम॥ 
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (3)
english_text:
aj siv siddh suresh mukh, japat rahat nisi jam. 
badha jan kee harat hai, radha radha nam.. 
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (3)

title: वृंदाटवी जयति कामगवी - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.36)
sanskrit_text:
वृंदाटवी जयति कामगवी-सुरद्रु चिन्तामणीनगणितानपि तुच्छयन्ती।
श्रीशंकरद्रुहिणमुख्य सुरेन्द्रवृन्ददुर्ज्ञेय दिव्यमहिमैक रजःकणेन॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.36)
english_text:
vrindatavee jayati kamagavee-suradru chintamaneenaganitanapi tuchchhayantee.
shreeshnkaradruhinamukhy surendravrindadurjnyey divyamahimaik rajhkanen..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.36)
english_translation:

title: मखमल माखन से इन्दु की मयूखन से - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (4)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
मखमल माखन से इन्दु की मयूखन से,
नूतन तमालपत्र आभा आभरन हैं। [1]
गुल से गुलाल से गुलाब जपा जावक से,
पावक प्रवाल लाल गावै भू धरन हैं॥ [2]
उमापति रमापति जमापति आठों याम,
ध्यावत रहत चारि फल के करन हैं। [3]
पंकज बरनि छबि छबिके हरन हठी,
सुख के करन राधे रावरे चरन हैं॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (4)
english_text:
(kavitta)
makhamal makhan se indu kee mayookhan se,
nootan tamalapatr aabha aabharan hain. [1]
gul se gulal se gulab japa javak se,
pavak praval lal gavai bhoo dharan hain.. [2]
umapati ramapati jamapati aathon yam,
dhyavat rahat chari fal ke karan hain. [3]
pnkaj barani chhabi chhabike haran hathee,
sukh ke karan radhe ravare charan hain.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (4)

title: पापात्मा पुण्यवान् वा प्रसरदपयशाः - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.68)
sanskrit_text:
पापात्मा पुण्यवान् वा प्रसरदपयशाः कीर्त्तिमान वा महादु- ष्प्राप-ग्रासोऽथ सम्राड़समजड़मतिः सर्वविद्यानिधिर्वा। 
यः कोऽपि स्याः सखे नो गणय कथमपीक्षस्व वृन्दावनं त- च्छिन्धि छिन्धि स्वपाशान् गुरुनिगमगिरा स्वीयमोहैकसिद्धान्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.68)
english_text:
papatma punyavan va prasaradapayashah keerttiman va mahadu- shprapa-grasoऽth samradasamajadamatih sarvavidyanidhirva. 
yh koऽpi syah sakhe no ganay kathamapeekshasv vrindavann ta- chchhindhi chhindhi svapashan gurunigamagira sveeyamohaikasiddhan..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.68)

title: नाहन्ता-ममते वृथा कुरु सखे - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.69)
sanskrit_text:
नाहन्ता-ममते वृथा कुरु सखे! देहालय-स्त्रयादिके छित्त्वा दुर्जरश्रृखलं गुरुगिरा ते मोहमात्रोदितम्। 
वृन्दारण्यमुपेत्य शीघ्रमखिलानन्दैकसाम्राज्यसत् कन्दं कन्दफलादि-वृत्तिरनिशं तन्नाथलीलां स्मर॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.69)
english_text:
nahanta-mamate vritha kuru sakhe! dehalaya-strayadike chhittva durjarashrrikhaln gurugira te mohamatroditam. 
vrindaranyamupety sheeghramakhilanandaikasamrajyasat kandn kandafaladi-vrittiranishn tannathaleelan smar..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (1.69)

title: गति पै गयन्द वारौं पग अरविन्द वारौं - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (98)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
गति पै गयन्द वारौं पग अरविन्द वारौं,
हठी अलि वृन्दवारौं अलकन फंद पै। [1]
गुल्फ पे गुलिन्द वारौं शीलता पै सिन्धु वारौं,
सकल सुगन्ध वारौं मुखकी सुगन्ध पै॥ [2]
कटि पै मृगेन्द्र वारौं तन छवि वृन्द वारौं,
बेनी पै कनींद्र वारों जात नदनंद पै। [3]
ओठ जीव बन्धु वारौं हाँसी सुधा कन्द वारौं,
कोटि-कोटि चन्द्र वारौं श्री राधा मुख चन्द पै॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (98)
english_text:
(kavitta)
gati pai gayand varaun pag aravind varaun,
hathee ali vrindavaraun alakan fnd pai. [1]
gulf pe gulind varaun sheelata pai sindhu varaun,
sakal sugandh varaun mukhakee sugandh pai.. [2]
kati pai mrigendr varaun tan chhavi vrind varaun,
benee pai kaneendr varon jat nadannd pai. [3]
oth jeev bandhu varaun hansee sudha kand varaun,
koti-koti chandr varaun shree radha mukh chand pai.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (98)

title: वृन्दारण्योत्तमं नास्ति - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (7.125)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दारण्योत्तमं नास्ति-नास्ति मत्तोऽधमं क्वचित्। 
राधा नाम्नः प्रभावेण-यदि स्यान्मेलनं तयोः॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (7.125)
english_text:
vrindaranyottamn nasti-nasti mattoऽdhamn kvachit. 
radha namnh prabhavena-yadi syanmelann tayoh..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (7.125)
english_translation:
vrindaranyottamn nasti-nasti mattoऽdhamn kvachit. 
radha namnh prabhavena-yadi syanmelann tayoh..
- shree prabodhannd sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (7.125)

title: नित्यं कामः किमपि कुरुते दुसहां - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (6.4)
sanskrit_text:
नित्यं कामः किमपि कुरुते दुसहां मर्मपीड़ा-मान्ध्यं क्रोधः किमपि कुरुते क्षोभयेल्लोभः उच्चैः।
दम्भसूया-मद पिशुनता-मत्सराद्यैः सुपूर्णः स्वार्थदभ्रष्टस्तदिह शरणं यामि वृन्दावन! त्वाम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (6.4)
english_text:
nityn kamh kimapi kurute dusahan marmapeedaa-mandhyn krodhh kimapi kurute kshobhayellobhh uchchaih.
dambhasooya-mad pishunata-matsaradyaih supoornh svarthadabhrashtastadih sharann yami vrindavan! tvam..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (6.4)
english_translation:

title: गिरि से गिराओ हमें - डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’, वृंदावन शतक (61)
sanskrit_text:
गिरि से गिराओ हमें गज से दबाओ हमें, 
अतुल निर्दयता से अग्नि में जलाओ नाथ। [1]
काल से डसाओ हमें व्याधि से ग्रसाओ हमें, 
शंभु से छिनाकर हलाहल पिलाओ नाथ॥ [2]
सिंह से लड़ाओ हमें सिन्धु में डुबाओ हमें, 
विजन विपिन बीच बिजली गिराओ नाथ। [3]
घोर से भी घोर दुःख दारुण दिखाओ किन्तु, 
हाय! हाय ! वृन्दावन-बास ना छुड़ाओ नाथ॥ [4]
- डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’, वृंदावन शतक (91)
english_text:
giri se girao hamen gaj se dabao hamen, 
atul nirdayata se agni men jalao nath. [1]
kal se dasao hamen vyadhi se grasao hamen, 
shnbhu se chhinakar halahal pilao nath.. [2]
sinh se ladaao hamen sindhu men dubao hamen, 
vijan vipin beech bijalee girao nath. [3]
ghor se bhee ghor duhkh darun dikhao kintu, 
hay! hay ! vrindavana-bas na chhudaao nath.. [4]
- dndee svamee shree hare krishnanand sarasvatee ‘hare krishna’, vrindavan shatak (91)

title: श्रीमद् वृन्दावनने रत्नवल्लीवृक्षै - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.38)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीमद् वृन्दावनने रत्नवल्लीवृक्षैश्चित्रज्योतिरानन्दपुष्पैः।
कीर्णे स्वर्णस्थल्युदञ्चत् कदम्बच्छायायां नश्चक्षुषी गौरनीले॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.38)
english_text:
shreemad vrindavanane ratnavalleevrikshaishchitrajyotiranandapushpaih.
keerne svarnasthalyudanychat kadambachchhayayan nashchakshushee gauraneele..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (2.38)

title: कीरति किसोरी वृषभान की दुलारी प्यारी - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (98)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कीरति किसोरी वृषभान की दुलारी प्यारी,
अरज हमारी सुकमारी कान कीजै री। [1]
भ्रमना भ्रमावै छिन छिन अकुलावै मन,
कछुना सुहावै उर धीरज धरीजै री॥ [2]
'लाल बलबीर' दासी चेरी हैं चरन ही की,
सरन लई हैं सो निभाय मोहि लीजै री। [3]
कीजै दीन जान दान एहो करुनानिधान,
सदा तेरौ ध्यान औ निकुंज बास दीजै री॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, राधा शतक (98)
english_text:
(kavitta)
keerati kisoree vrishabhan kee dularee pyaree,
araj hamaree sukamaree kan keejai ree. [1]
bhramana bhramavai chhin chhin akulavai man,
kachhuna suhavai ur dheeraj dhareejai ree.. [2]
'lal balabeer' dasee cheree hain charan hee kee,
saran laee hain so nibhay mohi leejai ree. [3]
keejai deen jan dan eho karunanidhan,
sada terau dhyan au nikunj bas deejai ree.. [4]
- shree lal balabeer jee, braj binod, radha shatak (98)

title: गरियो मौलीनामहमहह तेषां चरणयोः कृतः - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (12.55)
sanskrit_text:
गरियो मौलीनामहमहह तेषां चरणयोः कृतः स्वात्मन्यासः सुसुखमिदमायुः क्षपयिता।
अहो येषां राधाप्रियं रसमयं दिव्यं चरितामृत स्रोतो वृन्दावनमिदमहो मामनयत॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (12.55)
english_text:
gariyo mauleenamahamahah teshan charanayoh krith svatmanyash susukhamidamayuh kshapayita.
aho yeshan radhapriyn rasamayn divyn charitamrit sroto vrindavanamidamaho mamanayat..
- shree prabodhanand sarasvatee, vrindavan mahimamrit (12.55)

title: श्रीवृषभानु - कुमारि जू - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (13)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीवृषभानु - कुमारि जू, विनय करौं सुनि कान।
देहु निरन्तर आपने, चरन कमल कौ ध्यान॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (13)
english_text:
shreevrishabhanu - kumari joo, vinay karaun suni kan.
dehu nirantar aapane, charan kamal kau dhyan..
- shree lal balabeer jee, vrindavan shatak (13)
english_translation:

title: अद्भुत गुप्त मंत्र की महिमा - वृंदावन महिमामृत् शतक (15.73-76)
sanskrit_text: श्री प्रभोदनन्द सरस्वती जी ने लिखे अपने ग्रन्थ वृन्दावन महिमामृत में एक अद्भुत मन्त्र की महिमा बताई है, जिसे गुप्त रखा गया है।
english_text: shree prabhodanand sarasvatee jee ne likhe apane granth vrindavan mahimamrit men ek adbhut mantr kee mahima bataee hai, jise gupt rakha gaya hai.

title: राधे तेरे रूप की पटतर कहिये काहि - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (65)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
राधे तेरे रूप की, पटतर कहिये काहि।
सरबस तजि रसबस भये, नैन कोर तन चाहि॥
english_text:
(doha)
radhe tere roop kee, patatar kahiye kahi.
sarabas taji rasabas bhaye, nain kor tan chahi..
english_translation:

title: चन्द सो आनन कंचन सो तन - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (82)
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
चन्द सो आनन कंचन सो तन, हौं लखीकैं बिनमोल बिकानी। [1]
औ अरविन्द सो आँखिन कों 'हठी', देखत मेरी यै आँखी सिरानी॥ [2]
राजति हैं मनमोहन के संग, वारौं मैं कोटि रमारति रानी। [3]
जीवन मूरी सबैं ब्रज को, ठकुरानी हमारी है राधिका रानी॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (82)
english_text:
(savaiya)
chand so aanan knchan so tan, haun lakheekain binamol bikanee. [1]
au aravind so aankhin kon 'hathee', dekhat meree yai aankhee siranee.. [2]
rajati hain manamohan ke sng, varaun main koti ramarati ranee. [3]
jeevan mooree sabain braj ko, thakuranee hamaree hai radhika ranee.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (82)

title: ध्यावत महेश हू गनेश हू धनेश हू - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (52)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
ध्यावत महेश हू गनेश हू धनेश हू,
दिनेश हू फनेश त्यौं मुनेस मनमानी है। [1]
तीनों लोक जपत त्रिताप की हरन हार,
नवौ निध्दि सिद्धि मुक्ति भई दरबानी है॥ [2]
कीरति दुलारी सेवैं चरन बिहारी धन्य,
जाको कित्त नित्त विधि वेदन बखानी है। [3]
साधा काजपल में अराधा छिन आधा हठी,
बाधा हरिबे को एक राधा महारानी है॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (52)
english_text:
(kavitta)
dhyavat mahesh hoo ganesh hoo dhanesh hoo,
dinesh hoo fanesh tyaun munes manamanee hai. [1]
teenon lok japat tritap kee haran har,
navau nidhdi siddhi mukti bhaee darabanee hai.. [2]
keerati dularee sevain charan biharee dhany,
jako kitt nitt vidhi vedan bakhanee hai. [3]
sadha kajapal men aradha chhin aadha hathee,
badha haribe ko ek radha maharanee hai.. [4]
- shree hathee jee, radha sudha shatak (52)

title: नाम पतित पावन सुनि - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (83)
sanskrit_text:
नाम पतित पावन सुनि, निर्भय ह्वै कीय पाप।
यामें दोष बताउ मम, दोषी तो हैं आप॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (83)
english_text:
nam patit pavan suni, nirbhay hvai keey pap.
yamen dosh batau mam, doshee to hain aap..
- jagadguru shree kripalu jee maharaj, bhakti shatak (83)
english_translation:
